title: thelypteris metcalfei
intro: Thelypteris metcalfei, commonly known as the Metcalfe's maiden fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris metcalfei include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and promote healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
